new.s: In which year was the Communist Party banned in Hyderabad State?
new.x: Hyderabad State banned the Communist Party in December 1946. The all-India ban ran from 1934 to 1942, and Andhra (Madras) banned it in 1949.
new.angle: U0223 #4 Ban on the Communist Party -> year (Hyderabad State)

new.s: Whose killing at Kadavendi in Jangaon on 4 July 1946 triggered the Telangana Armed Struggle?
new.x: Doddi Komaraiah was killed by a deshmukh's men at Kadavendi on 4 July 1946, which set off the Telangana Armed Struggle. The others were Srikakulam leaders.
new.angle: U0223 #1 / PYQ y8840dbfc6ef Telangana struggle -> triggering incident

new.s: Which memoir was written by Ravi Narayana Reddy?
new.x: Ravi Narayana Reddy wrote Veera Telangana – Naa Anubhavalu, Gnapakalu. Visalandhralo Prajarajyam is by P. Sundarayya.
new.angle: U0223 #1 Memoirs -> author (Veera Telangana Anubhavalu Gnapakalu)

new.s: Which British Prime Minister announced the Communal Award in August 1932?
new.x: The Communal Award was announced on 16 August 1932 by British Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald, not by the Viceroy.

new.s: Which of the following was declared a minority and given a separate electorate for the first time by the Communal Award?
new.x: The Communal Award of 1932 declared the Depressed Classes a minority and gave them a separate electorate for the first time; Muslims had one since 1909.

new.s: Who was the first president of the All India Anti-Untouchability League, founded by Gandhi in 1932?
new.x: Gandhi founded the League on 30 September 1932, but its first president was G.D. Birla; Amritlal Thakkar was its secretary.

new.s: The Public Service Commission in India was provided for by Section 96(C) of which Act?
new.x: Section 96(C) of the Government of India Act, 1919 provided for a Public Service Commission, which was set up in 1926.
new.angle: U0225 #2 / PYQ y607855b08f7 Section -> body created (PSC)

new.s: Separate electorates for Muslims were first introduced by the Indian Councils Act of which year?
new.x: The Indian Councils Act, 1909 (Morley-Minto Reforms) first gave Muslims separate electorates; the 1919 Act extended them.
new.angle: U0225 #4 / PYQ y8a6973dbce1 Act -> communal electorate

new.s: Who was the Viceroy of India when separate electorates were introduced by the Indian Councils Act, 1909?
new.x: The 1909 Act is called the Morley-Minto Reforms after Secretary of State Morley and Viceroy Lord Minto.
new.angle: U0225 #10 / PYQ y8a6973dbce1 Act -> popular name + separate electorates

new.s: Which of the following Central Legislative Assembly elections was NOT held under the Government of India Act, 1919?
new.x: Central Legislative Assembly elections under the 1919 Act were held in 1923, 1926, 1930, 1934 and 1945. The 1937 elections were provincial elections under the 1935 Act.
new.angle: U0225 #5 / #17 Elections held under the 1919 Act vs the 1935 Act

new.s: In which year was the Third Round Table Conference held?
new.x: The Third Round Table Conference met in London from 17 November to 24 December 1932, without the Congress.
new.angle: U0226 #5 / PYQ yda13ff6b5f5 Round Table Conferences -> year

new.s: In which city were the three Round Table Conferences held?
new.x: All three Round Table Conferences (1930-32) were held in London under Prime Minister Ramsay MacDonald.

new.s: What was the main aim of the Round Table Conferences held in London during 1930-32?
o: To discuss the Simon report and a federal constitution for India
To plan the partition of India
To review the working of the Rowlatt Act
To set up a Constituent Assembly for India
new.x: The Round Table Conferences were called to discuss the Simon report and a federal constitution for India.
new.angle: U0226 #5 / PYQ ya9e402b46e9 Round Table Conference -> agenda

new.s: Which of the following was concluded in November 1937 to end the split between Coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema?
new.x: The Sri Bagh Pact was made in November 1937 at Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao's house to end the Coastal-Rayalaseema split.
new.angle: U0227 #3 / PYQ y092d3b8c4f4 Sri Bagh Pact -> year

new.s: The Congress ministries resigned in 1939 in protest against which act of Viceroy Lord Linlithgow?
o: Declaring India at war with Germany without consulting Indian leaders
new.x: On 3 September 1939 Linlithgow declared India at war with Germany without consulting Indian leaders, so the Congress ministries resigned in October-November 1939.
new.angle: U0227 #1 / PYQ y45829f22a53 Congress ministries -> reason for resignation

new.s: Which resolution was drafted by Sikandar Hayat Khan, the Unionist Premier of Punjab?
new.x: Sikandar Hayat Khan drafted the Lahore Resolution of 1940; Fazlul Huq moved it and Jinnah presided over the session.

new.s: Who gave the slogan 'Divide and Quit'?
new.x: During the Second World War Jinnah asked the British to 'Divide and Quit': divide India into Hindustan and Pakistan and then leave. 'Quit India' was Gandhi's call.
new.angle: U0228 #4 League's slogans -> leader (Divide and Quit)

new.s: Who is the author of 'The Man Who Divided India'?
new.x: 'The Man Who Divided India' is a book by Rafiq Zakaria. Ambedkar wrote 'Pakistan or the Partition of India'.
